offices.title: Village Trustee
offices.org_name: Village of Westminster Board of Trustees

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 289 (Village of Westminster): sec. 4: the officers of the corporation shall be a Board of five trustees, with five-year terms

Town of Westminster, Local Hazard Mitigation Plan profile: the Village of Westminster 'in recent times has performed no municipal functions... Its governance structure is all volunteer and consists of five trustees a treasurer and a clerk.' No official source names the current trustees, so the post is created without memberships
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 289 (Village of Westminster): sec. 4 elects a Clerk for a one-year term; the current holder is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 289 (Village of Westminster): sec. 4 elects a Treasurer for a one-year term; the current holder is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership
